notes: Wall-clock frames during actual forward input; active collision, normal chase camera, HUD, NPCs and traffic. Half-second movement windows detect stalls; more than one cumulative stalled second invalidates play. CPU Performance monitors are rolling engine observations, not per-frame traces. Direct viewport GPU/render CPU and global render setup timings are milliseconds; GPU results can lag. Screenshot writes plus 1.3s cooldown excluded. Slow/event frame counters indicate correlation, not causation.

audit.placement: Exact exported sidewalk/ground; reserved entrances, courts, architecture, trees and yard props
